text:
maria.docs: Quick QA pass on the Optimize toolkit docs — I ran the sample harness and a couple of SDK snippets don't match runtime flags in Dedicated preview. Opening a PR with fixes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 — can eng check batch/caching config names and the quant profile labels? :eyes:
kevin.eng: taking a look. Which snippet mismatched?
maría.docs: The Python example uses config 'continuous_batch' but the runtime expects 'continuous'. Also the quant profile is listed as 'q4_0_fast' in the docs but our profile in the catalog is 'q4_0_fast_v2'. Small but causes 400 on deploy.
alex.infra: confirmed — our manifest parsing accepts 'continuous' and 'batched_continuous' only. 'continuous_batch' will fail. I can push a small validator patch but docs should use the canonical names.
samira.ml: re: quant names — we rolled v2 to improve FP stability. Docs should recommend both and show fallback. Suggest a short table like: q4_0_fast_v2 (recommended), q4_0_fast (legacy).
maria.docs: thanks. Drafted an inline snippet update. Can someone sanity-check the Python and JS examples? Also adding a note about the automatic KV-prefetch toggle per workload. Snippets below:
```python
# Python SDK minimal: continuous batching + kv-prefetch
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}")
config = {
    "batching": "continuous",
    "kv_prefetch": true,
    "quant_profile": "q4_0_fast_v2"
}
resp = client.generate("Summarize the following text...", config=config)
print(resp.text)
```
```ts
// Typescript SDK example
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
const config = {
  batching: 'continuous',
  kvPrefetch: true,
  quantProfile: 'q4_0_fast_v2'
}
const resp = await client.generate('Summarize the following text...', config)
console.log(resp.text)
```
kevin.eng: LGTM, just one nit: JS casing should match SDK naming v2 — kvPrefetch is correct. For the Python SDK we accept both 'kv_prefetch' and 'kvPrefetch' but canonical docs should use snake_case.
maria.docs: noted — I'll switch Python to snake_case. Also planning to add a small troubleshooting blurb: what 400 errors look like when config names mismatch (sample error payload). Anyone have that payload?
alex.infra: pasted from staging logs: `{"error":"invalid_config_field","field":"batching","message":"unknown batching mode 'continuous_batch'"}` — use that exact JSON in the troubleshooting note.
samira.ml: adding a short quality note about quant tradeoffs: "q4_0_fast_v2 reduces hallucination on long contexts but may increase latency slightly vs q4_0_fast" — I'd like that sentence in the recommendations.
maria.docs: perfect. I'll update the PR with those changes. One more ask: there are two broken links in the Optimize -> Batching page to SDK param docs — I can fix them but need the canonical anchor names. docs-bot: preview deployed for PR 412 at https://deploy-preview-412--docs.redwood.ai/optimize/batching (expires in 48h).
docs-bot: :white_check_mark: preview build succeeded — https://deploy-preview-412--docs.redwood.ai/optimize/batching
kevin.eng: anchors are: `#sdk-params-python` and `#sdk-params-javascript` — fix those two links and ping me for a quick review.
maria.docs: done, pushed a new commit to the PR addressing names, casing, the error payload, and link anchors. Requesting quick review from @kevin.eng and @samira.ml — aiming to merge before EOD so the Console migration notes can point to stable docs. :thumbsup:
kevin.eng: will review in the hour. :+1:
samira.ml: will check the quant wording after lunch. :ok_hand:
